home.lead: This is my personal site. Here I gather my projects, code and texts. I write about what I'm working on, in two languages and without any publishing schedule.

home.passport_label: About the author and the site

principles.title: Focus on what matters
principles.text: I share what I have verified in practice and don't try to come across as an expert in everything. No invented stories for attention.

principles.title: A working space
principles.text: I openly write about technical decisions, experiments and my own mistakes. But my personal life stays off the site.

principles.title: Contact by email
principles.text: There are no comments, chats or intrusive pop-ups on the site. If you have a question or a suggestion — just write to me by email.

principles.title: No deadlines
principles.text: I update the pages only when I truly have something to share. Long breaks between posts are normal.
